screens.title: There are no right answers here
screens.body: You'll put a few things in order, answer one question, and get a short summary at the end. Nothing you choose is saved or sent anywhere.

screens.title: Put these in order
screens.body: Think about a relationship you'd want to be in a year from now.

fields.label: Most important first
fields.hint: If two feel equal, pick the one you'd miss more if it were gone.

options.label: Having fun and doing things together
Talking openly, including about hard things
Having time and space of your own

fields.label: How firm is your first choice?

options.label: Firm: I wouldn't stay without it
Strong, but I could talk about it

fields.label: Why does it matter to you? (optional)

feedback.text: Wanting time to yourself is a real need, not a lack of interest. Saying it early saves both people guessing.
Not knowing yet is normal. Trying things is partly how people find out.

screens.title: Your order
screens.body: You put things in this order: {{answer:priorities}}.
takeaways: Your order can change as you learn more about yourself.
A firm want is worth saying out loud early; a flexible one is worth talking through.
